cli.stdout:
Create a manual task

USAGE
  $ nocoreach task create [flags]

FLAGS
  --project <string>         (required)
  --request-id <string>      (required)
  --title <string>           (required)
  --description <string>     (required)
  --description-file <path>  Read --description from a file.
  --playbook-id <string>
  --attachment-ids <value>…  (default: [], repeat for more)

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --json            Print the result as one JSON document (the cli-envelope).
  --profile <name>  Act as this signed-in profile.
  -q, --quiet       Print only what a script needs.
  --no-color        Plain text, without colors.

DESCRIPTION
  Creates a pending task without starting execution. Identical requestId retries return the same task; changed input returns 409.

EXAMPLES
  $ nocoreach task create --project 1 --title "Review page" --description-file brief.md --request-id <uuid>
